provenance.note: Per-skill effect ids from the official C++ switches (ReceiveSkillUse + PlaySkillEffect) and from the roBrowserLegacy-derived 2019-era table the client data uses; official_assets are the renderable assets of the official effect implementations. Used by tools/audit_rodecomp_coverage.py. used_effect_ids/used_assets are the version-correct mapping: the 2019-era ids for the bard/dancer songs (the 2026 client reworked them) and for the drift skills whose 2019 effect name/description matches the skill (MO_STEELBODY -> EF_STEELBODY 254, HW_SOULDRAIN -> EF_ENERGYDRAIN 217 '(Wizard Soul Drain)', SG_*_COMFORT -> EF_BLUECASTING 441 'Comfort skills'); the official ids otherwise.
